name: ARA4003
title: Markup nests too deeply
summary: Elements nest deeper than 128 levels, the limit that keeps layout and hit testing bounded.
html:
Elements nest deeper than 128 levels, the limit that keeps layout and hit testing bounded.

#Common causes

  • Generated markup recurses without a bound.

#Fixes

  • Split the document into components or flatten wrapper panels.

  • Code: ARA4003

  • Constant: ui::DEPTH

  • Reported by: ara-ui-document
